decisions.statement: A client opened this way seats nothing and has no tmux session.
A client is reached through the pty proxy rather than run directly.
The terminal is reset once the client ends whatever status that client ended with.
The launcher ends with the status the client ended with.
A new account is named and given an address before any client opens on that account.
A new account named as nothing ends the launcher rather than opening a client.
A new account's own alias is there only once the set is composed again.

definition: the shell opening a client on one model account in the terminal it was typed in
